verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, and both have the same flaws. The orange headline panel fills only the top half of the left side, which leaves a dead white band under it. The photo is a cropped square floating mid-canvas with a big empty white strip to its right, so the banner reads as two disconnected pieces. 'HOW TO LEVEL UP' and the search-box text are shrunk to near-illegible size, and the layout is a shrunk copy, not a real left-to-right banner.
